name: Wake listener
author: Brett
description: An always-on wake-word listener for the console and the console Android app: say a wake phrase Brett sets in Settings (several allowed), then a command. Runs on-device (the console app's offline recognizer through the native bridge; the browser's recognizer elsewhere) with a mic-on light on the banner and an off switch. Every console action, plugin command, control@1 target and pipeline command has a voice entry built from the API registry (new plugins appear by themselves); a command with missing fields runs as a spoken wizard ('create a new project' → 'name?' → 'Gizmo Johnson' → confirm). 'Approve' reviews everything waiting on axHub one at a time (approve / deny / skip / approve all pending). REST /api/plugins/wake-listener (settings, on, off, state, catalog, match), MCP wake-listener_*, CLI listener.mjs / axf wake-listener, voice.

items.title: The wake listener's settings (on, wake phrases, engine, timings, replies, indicator)
Change the wake listener's settings; addPhrase / removePhrase add or drop one wake phrase
Switch the wake listener on (the open console starts listening)
Switch the wake listener off (the mic closes)
What the listener is doing now: phase, engine, mic open, last heard, last command, last reply
